audit_items.proof_trace: stem-bot-v2's GET /api/members (which returns student_number) is registered with authMiddleware (index.ts:77), which validates the Bearer token against API_AUTH_TOKEN before dispatch; no registration path bypasses this middleware. stem-system server actions getMemberDisplayName and getAllMemberNames both call supabase.auth.getUser() and return null for unauthenticated callers, and admin pages selecting supabase_auth_user_id/is_admin/student_number are fully gated by dashboard/admin/layout.tsx which checks session auth and is_admin before rendering children.
